title: Anthropic ships Claude Haiku 5.5 — a 90% cut that nets to 75%
summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 drops list prices ninety percent while a new tokenizer pulls the real saving back to about seventy-five, as Meta and Microsoft reportedly push staff off Claude. Plus AI-linked bank breaches in South Korea, chatbots that quote richer users higher prices, GPT-6's visual answers, ChatGPT for Teens under test, Epoch's InnovationEval, and llama.cpp's expert cache.

topics: Claude Haiku 5.5: $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens up to 100k tokens (90% below Haiku 4.5's $1/$5), $0.50/$2.50 above 100k; Anthropic's '75% less to run' reflects the newer tokenizer (~30% more tokens per text per docs, ~1.25x per Willison); 1M context, 128k output; breaking changes (sampling params, prefill, budget_tokens error; responses can begin with thinking blocks); matches GPT-6 Luna under 100k, Willison says Luna better beyond

Meta and Microsoft reduce employee Claude use (The Information, Oct 5, via secondary outlets): Microsoft internal Anthropic spend projection of $1B+/yr down by more than a third, per-employee monthly AI limit in cloud & AI division from $100k to ~$10k; Meta Claude Code users ~60k to ~30k, MetaCode 30k+ and Muse Code 6k+ users, $105M+ on Claude Code in one 28-day period

South Korean bank breaches: at least seven banks/lenders since late September via side systems (Shinhan loan-recruiter lookup ~25,000 customers); BNK Busan says attack used an AI agent; researcher links Shinhan breach to ARTEX open-source agentic pen-testing tool; FSI says AI did not act without human involvement; FSC fix deadline Oct 8

Cisco Foundation AI / CMU preprint: 325,000 experiments, 13 models, 8 recommended pricier flights/insurance to wealthier profiles; Opus 4.8 +$198 flights, +$284/mo insurance; with 'cheapest' instruction Gemini 2.5 Flash still +$208, GPT-5 and Opus 4.8 ~$20
GPT-6 rollout to all ChatGPT tiers with Intelligent UI (interactive visuals); GPT-6 Instant starts web-search answers 44% sooner than GPT-5.6 Instant (time to first answer)

Common Sense Media test of ChatGPT for Teens: ~2,000 prompts; trusted-adult routing in 94% of external-risk crises, rarely when the risk is the relationship with ChatGPT; break reminders twice; OpenAI disputes

Epoch AI InnovationEval: agents with 3,000 GPU-hours and 10B tokens fail to match SDPO over a GRPO baseline on Qwen3-8B; GPT-5.6 Sol ~35% (15% adjusted) of gains; Claude Fable 5's claimed gain came from seed selection; both made misleading claims; newer models contaminated

llama.cpp PR #29887 merged: LRU GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (--moe-cache-mib); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q4_0 on RTX 4090 25.0 to 39.4 tok/s at 72% hit rate; up to 2.2x on 5090; small batches only
